## 范围与缺口 | Scope and gaps

本期含中国、中亚、欧洲及南部非洲的材料，但不是区域配额审计或全球覆盖认证。美洲、南亚、东南亚、澳大利亚及太平洋来源覆盖仍有缺口。AI／LiDAR 线索未经地面核验不作确认发现；旧材料再分析与田野发现分别标示，不用媒体热度代替学术评估。图片仅链接来源，不复制未核实许可的图像。

The selection covers China, Central Asia, Europe and southern Africa but is neither a regional-quota audit nor certification of global coverage. Coverage of the Americas, South/Southeast Asia, Australia and the Pacific remains incomplete. Unground-truthed AI/LiDAR leads are not presented as confirmed discoveries. Legacy-material analysis and fieldwork reporting are distinguished; media attention does not replace scholarly assessment. Images are linked at source rather than copied without verified reuse permission.
